reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "⚠️ Remove 3rd party lua plugin support (#11821) ⚠️ This removes the following configuration options: * `plugins` It also removes support for user provided Lua…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: The `plugins` configuration option is removed, so it is no longer honoured. User-provided Lua plugins in /etc/nginx/lua/plugins are no longer supported.
consequence.remediation: Before upgrading, remove the `plugins` setting and stop relying on custom Lua plugins in /etc/nginx/lua/plugins. Replace their function by other means.

proposed.statement: ingress-nginx 1.12.0 removes support for 3rd-party Lua plugins: it drops the `plugins` configuration option and no longer supports user-provided Lua plugins in /etc/nginx/lua/plugins.
